SQLite is in the Public Domain
--------------------------------

All of the code and documentation in SQLite has been dedicated to the public
domain by its authors (https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html).

The native SQLite library (e_sqlite3) bundled inside the SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3
package that is included in this product's backend is therefore free for any use,
without attribution requirements.

The Apache-2.0 licensed wrapper (SQLitePCLRaw) is covered by
SQLitePCLRaw-LICENSE.txt and SQLitePCLRaw-NOTICE.txt in this directory.
